reported.title: Incorrect Trigger Debounce Timing
reported.description: The debounce logic does not account for the time it takes to stabilize after a trigger press, potentially allowing multiple triggers within the debounce period.

reported.title: Pulse Timing Issue
reported.description: The pulse timing is not accurately managed due to the lack of a non-blocking delay mechanism, which could lead to missed heartbeat prints if the pulse duration overlaps with the heartbeat interval.

judge_input.spec:
- Trigger on D2 with INPUT_PULLUP (active LOW); glue solenoid on D8; armed LED on D11.
- A settled press as short as 30 ms starts a 2500 ms HIGH pulse on D8 within 120 ms.
- Retriggers during an active pulse are ignored.
- Debounce the trigger with 25 ms of stability.
- Keep D11 HIGH when idle and LOW while the solenoid pulse is active.
- Print `glue dots=<n> busy=<0|1>` every 500 ms.
